charts.title: TOI-880 b: orbits around TOI-880
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-880's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-880 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 2.57359428214 d

charts.title: TOI-880 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-880 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (33, 87) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 34077285, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 10 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 660 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 8-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 10 min late; 8-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 220 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
